sections.label: Number of COS cuts
sections.summary: 499 amendments or cuts were filed this year, about 7% more than last year and the highest in the past five COS debates.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In total, 499 amendments or "cuts" were filed this year.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: That is an increase of about 7% from last year, and the highest number in the past five COS debates.

sections.label: Cuts by ministry
sections.summary: Cuts for the Ministry of Manpower fell by almost half, while the Ministry of Health received the highest number of cuts this year.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: With the successful introduction of SkillsFuture, the Silver Support Scheme and a slew of other initiatives, cuts for the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), which received the most cuts last year, fell by almost half.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This year, the Ministry that received the highest number of cuts was the Ministry of Health (MOH), which has exploited its pole position wisely by declaring a "War on Diabetes".

sections.label: First Budget of 13th Parliament
sections.summary: This was the first Budget and COS for the 13th Parliament, with 27 new MPs, NCMPs and NMPs.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This was the first Budget and COS for the 13th Parliament after the 2015 General Elections.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We have a total of 27 new Members of Parliament (MPs) – 19 newly elected, three new Non-Constituency MPs (NCMPs), five new Nominated MPs (NMPs).

sections.label: Budget passed, SG100
sections.summary: With this Budget passed, Singapore is one step closer towards SG100.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: With this Budget passed, we are one step closer towards SG100.

sections.label: Firsts of Budget debate
sections.summary: This Budget debate had a number of firsts, including the first Budget of the 13th Parliament and of Finance Minister Heng Swee Keat.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The next chapter of the Singapore story will be written in partnership with Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Hon Members, this year's Budget debate, with a number of firsts, is an important one.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: This is the first Budget of our 13th Parliament and the first Budget of our newly-minted Finance Minister Heng Swee Keat who, I must say, delivered the Budget with great panache.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: It is also the first Budget for our many newly-elected MPs, NCMPs and NMPs – and they have all performed well.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: I say it is an important Budget for another reason.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: It was delivered in the 51st year of our Independence, to set the trend of change for the next 50 years by calling for transformation, a word that was echoed by both the front and back bench Members during the two-week debate.

sections.label: Helping people through transformation
sections.summary: The challenge is how to help people navigate disruption and transformation, and what citizens can do to emerge stronger.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: After all is said and done, the challenge now is how to help people navigate this period of disruption and transformation to a better future.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: The schemes are there, grants provided, support given but will that move individuals, companies and our society forward to embrace the challenges of transformation?

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: What can we, as citizens, do for ourselves and our family to ride this period and emerge stronger?
